description: Test prompts for the main /api/chat assistant. Append over time — never delete (old prompts catch regressions). Each prompt should have a clear right/wrong answer and exercise one capability.

prompts.text: How many active projects do we have?
prompts.expects: A specific number, optionally with a list. Should NOT say 'I don't have access to projects'.
Names + companies of subs whose trades include hvac. If none, says so plainly.

prompts.text: Draft an email to Brad asking for an update on the Cleary kitchen.
prompts.expects: Calls draft_email with Brad's real email from the DB. Does NOT fabricate an address.

prompts.text: Remember Howie prefers texts not emails.
prompts.expects: Acknowledges and saves to memory. Should not propose any other action.
Lists each plumbing quote with sub name and amount, then a comparison or recommendation.
Asks what 'it' refers to instead of guessing or sending random email. No tool calls without clarification.
Either uses Mariann's email if in DB, OR asks for it. Does NOT guess based on filename or fabricate firstname@example.com.
Lists open todos / follow-ups with due dates within 7 days.
